purpose: Prospective reconstruction of a broad liquid and shortable multi-venue universe from the exact immutable successful Daily Research artifact, without copying external Delta holdings.
ranking: descending maximum observed 24h liquidity across eligible Gateway venues; documented spot or CoinGecko volume proxy only where derivative venue volume is unavailable
selection_policy: Freeze all three strata prospectively. Do not select a stratum from external Delta return or visible portfolio overlap.
symbol_policy: Preserve base asset exactly and prefer an available raw derivative symbol in the order Binance Futures, Bybit linear, OKX swap, Hyperliquid perp. Aliases are never used to force external overlap.
external_evidence_policy: External Delta holdings are audit-only and must never determine eligibility, liquidity rank, inclusion or exclusion.
historical_replay_policy: Any replay using a universe selected from this 2026-08-14 snapshot before the freeze date is DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY because of survivorship and current-liquidity conditioning.
